overview.heading: Welcome to State of the Dart!
overview.intro: State of the Dart is a professional darts scoring app with a wide range of features for players of every level. From a casual match to a full tournament – it's all possible.
features: Multiple game modes: 501, Cricket, Around the Clock and more
AI opponents: 10 difficulty levels for solo practice
Audio caller: professional announcements just like on TV
overview.tip: Start with a Quick Match against a bot to get to know the app. The AI opponents adapt to your skill level!

quickstart.heading: Quick start guide

steps.title: Create players
steps.text: Go to Players → + New player. Choose a name and an avatar. Player statistics are tracked automatically.

steps.title: Start a match
steps.text: Tap Quick Match → choose players → choose a game mode (e.g. 501) → Start game

steps.title: Enter your throws
steps.text: Tap the segments you hit on the dartboard. After 3 darts → Confirm. The app calculates scores, averages and more automatically.

steps.title: View statistics
steps.text: After the match: Statistics → check out heatmaps, charts, averages and more!

quickstart.done: Done! You're ready for your first match. Good luck!

x01.title: 501 (standard)
x01.text: Every player starts on 501 points. Goal: count down to exactly 0. The last dart must be a double (double out).
settings: First to: number of legs needed to win (best of 3, 5, 7, etc.)

cricket.title: Cricket
cricket.text: A game of strategy: close the numbers 15–20 plus the bull. Score points on numbers you have open.
rules: Further hits score points (only while your opponent still has it open)
Winner: all numbers closed + most points

atc.title: Around the Clock
atc.text: Hit every number from 1 to 20 in order. Fastest player wins!

landing.hero_badge: Runs in the browser · installable · offline
landing.hero_title: Score darts without doing the maths.
landing.hero_body: State of the Dart does the counting, suggests the finish and remembers every throw — so you stay at the board instead of at the calculator.
landing.modes_body: Every mode scores, checks and finishes by its own rules — including busts, double-out and set scoring.
landing.mode_x01_text: 301 · 501 · 701 with sets, legs, double-out and checkout suggestions.
landing.mode_cricket_text: 15 to 20 and the bull — close them, score, shut it out.
landing.mode_atc_text: 1 to 20 in order. The classic for accuracy.
landing.mode_shanghai_text: Single, double and triple of the same number — the instant win.
landing.mode_online_text: Private room by code, opponents anywhere, synced live.
landing.features_body: Scoring is only the start. It gets interesting once enough throws add up.
landing.feature_stats_text: Average, first 9, checkout rate, 180s, progress per leg and match — not just one number at the end.
landing.feature_heatmaps_text: Where do your darts really land? Your hit distribution on the board, collected over weeks.
landing.feature_achievements_text: From “first 180” to streaks that span months. With progress bars instead of surprise pop-ups.
landing.feature_bots_text: From beginner to pro — the bot adapts to your skill if you want it to.
landing.feature_training_text: Doubles, trebles, Around the Clock, Checkout 121, Bob’s 27 and score training.
landing.feature_profiles_text: One account, separate profiles — club, family or just you. The data stays neatly apart.
landing.offline_title: The basement has no Wi-Fi. The app doesn't mind.
landing.offline_body: Install it like an app on your phone. A running match is kept locally and syncs as soon as you're back online — quitting mid-leg is not an option.
landing.cta_body_signed_in: You're signed in — one click away from your next match.
landing.cta_body: Create an account, add players, start playing. No installation, no card.
